https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/base/html/sprintf.html

It's in the base package.  If you're having problems calling it, there might be something bigger that's wrong with your installation.  What error message are you seeing?  When you run this code, does your result match?

> base::sprintf("%+0.2f", 9.4444444444)
[1] "+9.44"
